estimate: Apollo 16 suited jump took off at 1.17 m/s and rose 0.42 m on the Moon (https://www.nasa.gov/history/alsj/a16/a16.alsepoff.html); the same push in Mars gravity: 1.17^2 / (2 x 3.73) = 0.18 m
